changelog: **Affiliate module, admin screens (#3116):** `/admin/affiliates` gets tabs for Partners, Payments, Commissions, Payouts and Settings, behind new permissions `affiliate.read` (every admin tier) and `affiliate.write` (ORG_ADMIN; reads only while impersonating). Settings: the commission plan (`savePlan()`, EUR only for now via `AFFILIATE_CURRENCIES`; a real change bumps `planVersion`, stamps `planEffectiveAt` and re-evaluates every partner, existing commissions stay frozen) and the EN/TR/DE contract. Partners: create (referral code unique per org, case-insensitive), suspend / reactivate / terminate with an effective date under the partner lock (`changePartnerState()`), audited full-IBAN reveal. Payments: manual entry through `recordAffiliatePayment()` (amounts typed as `19,99`, calendar-day dates). Commissions: approve / reject / un-approve under the lock (`transitionCommissions()`, PAID never moves) and a read-only drift list. Payouts: `createPayout()` marks one partner's selected APPROVED commissions PAID together or not at all. Every money write is audited.

en: Run your affiliate programme in the CRM: set the commission plan and partner contract, add partners, record customer payments, approve commissions and record payouts — every change is logged.
tr: Affiliate programınızı CRM'de yönetin: komisyon planını ve partner sözleşmesini belirleyin, partner ekleyin, müşteri ödemelerini kaydedin, komisyonları onaylayın ve payout'ları kaydedin — her değişiklik kayıt altında.
de: Führen Sie Ihr Partnerprogramm im CRM: Provisionsplan und Partnervertrag festlegen, Partner anlegen, Kundenzahlungen erfassen, Provisionen freigeben und Auszahlungen erfassen — jede Änderung wird protokolliert.
